text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Zenno Rob Roy, we noticed an elderly person looking around anxiously.

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: Hmm, which way was the station, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me...
Are you by any chance looking for the station...?

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm afraid I'm not very familiar with this area...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... if it's alright with you,
shall I guide you to the station...?

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Well, thank you!
In that case, could I leave it to you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes...! I'll show you the way...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... from here on...
there are two ways we can go—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
First, take the route where you turn right at the crossroad 300 meters ahead, by the liquor store.
It takes about 8 minutes to reach the station.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's the shortest route, but there are two hills along the way, so it might be a bit tough.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The other route is to go straight and take a right
at the end of the road. It's flat, but it will take
about four minutes longer."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to choose whichever path you prefer...
B-But what do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a big help! In that case,
could you show me a route without any hills, dear?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood...!
Ah, allow me to carry your luggage...!

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: Phew... Sorry for taking things so slow.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, please don't mind me...! Um,
if you're tired, would you like to sit down and rest?

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Well, sorry to trouble you,
but I'll take you up on that offer, then.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes...! Of course...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Um, if I remember right, the nearest bench isâ
just around this left turn.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Right this way, ma'am.
Allow me to guide you.
choice_data_list: (Rob Roy looks so full of life!)
(Rob Roy looks so full of life!)

text_block_list.text:
After resting on a bench for a while,
we began walking back toward the station,
when dark clouds suddenly started rolling in across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the weather's looking rather grim.
I didn't bring an umbrella, so we'd better hurry.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: My umbrella is... Yeah, but it's fine! Let's change to a route where we won't get wet.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's just one turn off the path, so the distance hardly changes at all. Come, this way...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This shopping district has a covered arcade, so no worries even if it rains!
Once we make it through here, the station is right ahead!
choice_data_list: (I can't believe she even knows a route to stay dry!)

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Zenno Rob Roy's precise directions,
we arrived safely at the station!

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Aww, thank you so much!
You took care of absolutely everything for me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just glad I could help!
Please take care on the rest of your way.

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks so much for your kindness!
See ya later, then."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haa... thank goodness.
Looks like I guided them properly...!
choice_data_list: That was amazing! You memorized the whole route!
That was amazing! You memorized the whole route!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thank you very much.
To tell the truth, I've always been pretty good at giving directions...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I've loved looking at maps
of the settings while reading stories.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Through forests, highways, and even city alleyways—
Recalling the story, unrolling the map,
imagining every single corner of that world...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Maybe having fun playing like that helped me get a little better at remembering the scenery...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When it was decided that I'd enter Tracen Academy,
the first thing I did was look at a map of this town and
imagine all sorts of things about what kind of place it would be.
choice_data_list: That's a talent only Rob Roy could pull off!
That's a talent only Rob Roy could pull off, huh!
Maybe I'll have you show me around somewhere next time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When it was decided that I'd enter Tracen Academy,
the first thing I did was look at a map of this town and
imagine all sorts of things about what kind of place it would be.
choice_data_list: That's a talent only Rob Roy could pull off!
That's a talent only Rob Roy could pull off, huh!
Maybe I'll have you show me around somewhere next time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ! A special skill, unique to me...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see... A specialty that's mine and mine alone...!
You're right...!
Zenno Rob Roy savored the joy, feeling her confidence grow.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, leave it to me...!
I think I can guide you to most shops and facilities
within walking distance from the academy...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Hearing you say that
makes me feel confident, yeah...!

Zenno Rob Roy savored the small spark
of confidence within herself.
